fields.scientific_name: Microtubule track provision for vesicle movement

temporal_scope.start_condition: Microtubule is present and vesicle movement along it begins.
temporal_scope.end_condition: Vesicle movement along the microtubule ceases or the microtubule is no longer available as a track.

support.quote: provide a track along which vesicles move through the cell
They help the cell resist compression, provide a track along which vesicles move through the cell, and pull replicated chromosomes to opposite ends of a dividing cell.

exceptions.description: If microtubules are not present or not serving as tracks, this provision does not hold.

issue_resolution.reason: Reverted to the original source-supported framing: E_9af4c0e6bde1 states microtubules provide a track along which vesicles move, but does not name or describe motor proteins mediating vesicle transport. Motor-protein-dependent claims are left unresolved rather than asserted.

Removed the motor-protein-mediated causal chain and motor-cargo binding process because the retrieved evidence does not support motor proteins as actors in vesicle-specific transport; E_9af4c0e6bde1 supports only that vesicles move along microtubule tracks.

The observable obs_vesicle_transport_relation now uses only the source-supported relation (rel_microtubule_track_for_vesicle) with DETERMINISTIC capability, directly quoting E_9af4c0e6bde1 on vesicles moving along microtubule tracks.

Track provision is reframed as the source-supported structural/interaction process: microtubules provide a track for vesicle movement, with start/end tied to vesicle movement; no unsupported motor-protein requirement is retained. E_9af4c0e6bde1 does not describe track provision as an active microtubule process, so this remains a teaching simplification.
Vesicle states are limited to moving_along_microtubule and stationary, supported by E_9af4c0e6bde1; unsupported motor-bound state removed.

Model content now matches the supported scope of E_9af4c0e6bde1 (microtubule tracks for vesicle movement) and does not assert motor-protein-dependent mechanisms that the evidence does not support; this limitation is recorded in unresolved_questions.
Directionality, motor protein identity (kinesin/dynein), and organism specificity remain unresolved because the retrieved evidence E_9af4c0e6bde1 does not specify them; no unsupported claims added.

Migrated to typed state model: initial conditions are microtubule present as track and vesicle present; track provision produces microtubule available as track; transport requires available track and vesicle present and produces vesicle moving along microtubule. All states supported by E_9af4c0e6bde1. No unsupported motor-protein states retained.
